headline: Inside: Niacinamide, Matmarine and Zinc

actives.name: Niacinamide
actives.line: Vitamin B3 that reduces sebum, improves the barrier and evens skin tone

actives.name: Matmarine
actives.line: Biotechnological ingredient to reduce excess sebum, shine, pores and spots

actives.name: Zinc
actives.line: Regulates sebum production; suited to oily, acne-prone skin

footnote: Also contains Acetyl Glucosamine. Evaluated for safety through patch testing.
layout_description: Square 1080x1080. Headline top-left. Three active rows stacked down the left half: concentration (where printed) in large type, ingredient name, then a one-line role, separated by thin rules (the competitor's ingredient-to-benefit tag cards, rebuilt calmly). Real pack shot on the right 45%, standing on the surface. CTA bottom-left; footnote along the bottom edge.
image_prompt: Square 1080x1080 background plate only. A smooth off-white surface against a seamless pale blush-grey wall, soft natural daylight from the upper right, with one small smooth pale stone resting near the lower right corner and a soft gradient shadow. Palette of off-white, very pale blush and soft grey, a muted nod to a pink set in a clinical, minimal style. Keep the right 45% of the frame as clear, evenly lit empty space on the surface, reserved for a photo composited later. Keep the left 50% calm and low-detail as empty space for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Kept: the ingredient-explainer structure (pack plus three ingredient-to-benefit rows) and a soft pink mood, muted to Minimalist's palette. Replaced the competitor's actives with our own from F3, F16-F18; only Niacinamide has a printed concentration, so the other two rows leave pct blank. Dropped: fruit props and drip (scent/'natural' story), the 'NEW' bubble, 'Brightens skin' framing (our page says evens skin tone), 'Clinically Proven', 'Dermatologically Tested', 'No Nasties', and emoji.
